title: Moving a customer keeps open work orders on their tier and prices
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, with one range from $0.00: Default Markup % 50, tier A Markup % 20.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on Default for work orders and Default for Part Sales.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a category A part line at a cost of $10.00.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page from Customers.
  2. Click the edit pencil on the customer card.
  3. Open the Work Order Tier picker.
  4. Pick tier A.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Open work order 1.
  7. Click Add Part under line 1.
  8. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  9. Type 1 in Qty.
  10. Pick category A in Category.
  11. Type 20.00 in Cost.
  12. Click Save.
  13. Create a new work order for customer A.
  14. Add a category A part to the new work order at a cost of $20.00.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A's page opens.

Step 2:

  • Edit Customer opens.

Step 3:

  • The picker lists tier A.

Step 4:

  • Work Order Tier reads tier A.

Step 5:

  • The card shows tier A for work orders.
  • The message reads "Existing work orders and Part Sales keep their prices and tier."

Step 6:

  • Work order 1's first part still sells at $15.00 ($10.00 × 1.50 = $15.00, Default).
  • Its price shows no Manual icon.

Step 7:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 8:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 9:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 10:

  • Category shows category A.

Step 11:

  • Cost holds 20.00 as typed.

Step 12:

  • The new part on work order 1 sells at $30.00 ($20.00 × 1.50 = $30.00): work order 1 still uses Default.
  • It shows no Manual icon.

Step 13:

  • The new work order opens for customer A.

Step 14:

  • The part on the new work order sells at $24.00 ($20.00 × 1.20 = $24.00): new work orders use tier A.
